snippet.title: Tidy Slot Cars Announce Trailer - Sort 1,497 slot cars and take your favourites to the track!
snippet.description:
Sort 1,497 cars by model and colour in this cozy first-person organising game. Unlock cars as you tidy, build your own circuits, and race your cat or a friend in local split-screen.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5292860/Tidy_Slot_Cars/
